That changed after the 2020 presidential election , when secretaries of state in places such as Arizona, Georgia and Michigan were thrust into battles over election results, certification and false claims of widespread fraud. Fallon / AFP—Getty Images Southern California towns are on high alert as the first Santa Ana winds of the season have arrived, igniting multiple blazes across the region. The red flag warning put out by the National Weather Service (NWS) Wednesday evening followed a relatively quiet wildfire season so far in California . Only 300,000 acres had burned since Jan. 1, compared to the over one million acres that fires have usually burned by mid-October. Why are Santa Ana winds so dangerous? Santa Ana winds blow in from the desert, typically between the months of September and May. The winds bring warmer temperatures and drier air to Southern California. They also greatly increase the risk of wildfires—warm winds coupled with summer drought can often make for a dangerous combination.
